description: This file defines a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' that encapsulates the logic for generating, retrieving, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions within a workflow. It interacts with external AI models, vector stores, image processors, and storage systems to produce high-quality, contextually relevant questions for a medical education application.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: A class that manages the workflow nodes for generating, retrieving, validating, and finalizing medical exam questions, integrating various AI and storage components.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the QuestionGeneratorNodes with AI client, embedding manager, image processor, vector store, and storage, along with caches.

methods.name: _get_cached_questions
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter from cache or storage, with a 30-second cache duration.

methods.name: _calculate_question_similarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: _extract_medical_terms
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: _is_question_unique
methods.description: Checks if a question is unique compared to existing questions based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: _extract_covered_topics
methods.description: Extracts main topics from recent questions to avoid repetition.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores
methods.description: Tracks quality scores for source chunks based on question confidence.

methods.name: retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context chunks from vector store with smart selection based on question coverage and diversity.

methods.name: generate_question
methods.description: Generates a new medical exam question using GPT, incorporating context, images, and ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: validate_accuracy
methods.description: Validates the generated question for medical accuracy, quality, and uniqueness.

methods.name: add_citations
methods.description: Finalizes the question by adding source metadata, confidence scores, and updating quality tracking.
